title: One Red Night
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Deterministic persistent finale to Bathed in Red: Deckard contract, Protocon alliance, Night City Plaza, silver-card investigation, Seral Grove and player-owned truth/burial resolutions.
premise: After Bathed in Red, the Crew is hired to hunt Red Knight and follows a trail through Pacifica Playground, Protocon and Night City Plaza to Seral Grove.
publicBackground: Red Knight has declared war on the Crew and another Deckard relative has been killed.
gmBackground: Red Knight is Roman Deckard, whose apparent death was part of his own plan. Michael Deckard knows more than he admits and wants the scandal buried. This identity and the Grove evidence remain sealed until authored discovery.

startDefinition.openingSituation: The Crew prepares for a 6:00 p.m. meeting with Michael Deckard at Pleasant Valley Apartments after their Fixer relays a 3,000eb job.

locations.name: Pleasant Valley Apartments
locations.descriptionPublic: A discreet neo-luddite apartment building in Pacifica Playground.
locations.descriptionGM: Michael offers 3,000eb to find and kill Red Knight plus use of the apartment for one month.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Mister Rice Guy
locations.descriptionPublic: A colorful automated sushi restaurant next door to Pleasant Valley.
locations.descriptionGM: Raegan mistakes the Crew for Red Knight; Inquisitors can escalate the misunderstanding. Multiple authored methods can convince Protocon the Crew is not Red Knight.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Night City Plaza
locations.descriptionPublic: Protocon performs an outdoor concert designed to draw Red Knight into the open.
locations.descriptionGM: The crowd begins neutral at 0, bounded from -2 to +2. Crew actions can influence crowd safety and mood; a drone disrupts the show. Mechanical checks belong to Rules Engine.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Seral Grove Service Tunnel
locations.descriptionPublic: A service tunnel outside the Executive Zone opens with the silver card.
locations.descriptionGM: The card can be identified through Protocon, Michael, Data Pool research, a Fixer, or another legitimate player-created route.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Seral Grove
locations.descriptionPublic: A secret neon memorial park where metal and holography replace nature.
locations.descriptionGM: Red Knight controls the NET Architecture and defenses. The Deckard plot contains Red Knight and the evidence that reveals the truth.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Out in the Light
locations.descriptionPublic: The Crew releases the evidence about Red Knight and the Deckard scandal.
locations.descriptionGM: Michael does not pay and the apartment access is revoked; Michael becomes an enemy while Protocon becomes a friend. Red Knight's disposition remains the Crew's choice.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Buried Past
locations.descriptionPublic: The Crew destroys the evidence and finishes Michael Deckard's job quietly.
locations.descriptionGM: Destroying the audio diary chip and concealing Red Knight satisfies Michael's contract and pays the promised 3,000eb. The engine never auto-selects this outcome.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Michael Deckard
npcs.motivation: Stop Red Knight while keeping the Deckard scandal out of public view.
goals: Keep the truth out of the press
npcs.publicKnowledge: Lilah's missing husband and father of Roman and Layla.
npcs.secretKnowledge: He knows Red Knight is his son and wants the evidence buried.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Present the 3,000eb contract and apartment stipend as an offer; never accept it for the player.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Anya
npcs.publicKnowledge: The naturalist previously encountered at Delirium.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: May connect Raegan to Layla if the Crew needs that authored lead.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Raegan 'Pro' Halley
npcs.motivation: Draw Red Knight out and learn what happened to Layla.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Recognizes the silver card as Seral Grove access and has family entombed there.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Initial accusation is a misunderstanding; allow social, strategic, retreat and combat paths to resolve it.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Shannah
npcs.motivation: Protect the band and stop Red Knight.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Protocon's drummer and de facto manager.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Can offer 500eb to secure Crew participation in the concert plan if they do not otherwise buy in.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Kinneth
npcs.personality: Sharp and willing to call a truce.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Supports nonlethal resolution of the restaurant misunderstanding.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Red Knight
npcs.motivation: Punish those blamed for the Deckard family's suffering.
npcs.publicKnowledge: A murderous vigilante who has targeted the Crew and Deckards.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Red Knight is Roman Deckard; the apparent murder in Bathed in Red was part of his own plan.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Never reveal Roman's identity before the authored Grove discovery. Defeat, medical aid, custody or death remain mechanical/player-owned outcomes.
